summary: Protocol-level tests all pass (82 backend + 114 frontend), but two acceptance criteria are unmet: no sanitized real-client trace regression fixtures exist, and deployment/user docs do not document the Apple Calendar feature.
defects: No sanitized real-client trace regression fixtures exist in the repository. `glob **/*fixture*` and `glob **/*trace*` return no files. Acceptance criterion 'sanitized real-client traces become regression fixtures' is not met.

Deployment docs (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) contain no mention of CalDAV or Apple Calendar. No user-facing setup docs exist. Task manifest has docs_required=true. Acceptance criterion 'deployment/user docs match behavior' is not met.
follow_up: Real-device testing on current macOS and iOS clients cannot be verified in this environment; protocol-level tests pass but the acceptance criterion explicitly requires real client validation.
important_context: All 82 CalDAV event-resource tests and 114 frontend tests pass. The CalDAV implementation covers connect, sync-collection, CRUD, all-day, recurrence, permissions, and client-property preservation. The gap is in T19-specific deliverables: real-client trace fixtures and user/deployment documentation.
